definitions.availability: All 54 games have team/player, advanced, drives and play-by-play responses. Cross-provider agreement is corroboration; ESPN and CFBD may share upstream data.
definitions.explosives: Pass Reception/Passing Touchdown gains >=20; Rush/Rushing Touchdown gains >=10. Returns, penalties and ambiguous fumble types excluded. Denominator is provider advanced plays; not a universal explosive-rate definition.
definitions.non_offense: Validated ESPN scoring types for return touchdowns, safeties, defensive conversions; point deltas include conversions bundled with touchdown by ESPN. Not a counterfactual adjusted final. Version 2 additionally recognizes Sack-labeled defensive fumble-return touchdowns only with matching ESPN/CFBD play IDs, scoring-team orientation, clock, post-play scores and descriptions.
definitions.personnel: Observed passer box scores do not establish medical clearance, causal injury effects, or what was known before kickoff. Pregame context remains in original timestamped versions.
definitions.plays_and_drives: Provider advanced offensive counts; raw drives separately reported. Counts differ by provider inclusion of end-half/zero-play drives. Play volume is not clock-adjusted tempo.

Thursday weather is 5 mph wind and 19-22% rain probability; no strong Under signal. Final backup, OL and defensive availability remains unconfirmed; depth-chart listing is not medical clearance.
